name: MC Advanced Info Fetch
description: Read-only endpoints mounted at 127.0.0.1:3420/aif by MGHttpdProvider that report the player position, facing, vitals and status effects (/aif/info), the carried inventory, offhand, armor and any open furnace or chest (/aif/inventory), the current dimension/time/weather (/aif/world), every chat line since the previous request (/aif/msg), and every sound played since the previous request (/aif/sound, plus the filtered /aif/keysnd) as plain technical text. Split out of mcctl.
